name: Unidentified round-faced species
description: A humanoid sentient species had yellow skin and black eyes. The species had round faces, large chins, and a lack of visible nostrils. One female member of the species was active by 34 ABY, often frequenting the establishment Vranki's Hotel and Casino as a patron. That year, the elderly woman played a game at one of the casino's brightly lit machines, laughing in delight when she won.
